title: Rav Chaninah bar Minyumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Abaye, as in [Bava Batra 131a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.131a.13), and Menachot 70b (supplied; compare [70a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.70a.6)), where he raised a difficulty to Abaye; Hyman quotes [Zevachim 83b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.83b.6) as reading, ‘Rabbi Chananya bar Menyumi taught in the school of Rabbi Eliezer ben Jacob,’ and cites [Menachot 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.26b.17) as a parallel; and in [Yoma 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.45b.2) the reading is 'Rabbi Chananya bar Menyuma'.[^3]

notes.text: The supplied heading has Chaninah, while the reporting passages have Chananyah; Minyumi and Minyuma also differ. The forms are retained rather than silently harmonized.
The consulted Menachot 26b text names Rav Chanina bar Minyomei. Hyman’s Chananya and Minyuma forms follow the readings he cites.

[Seder HaDorot 1476](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1476&lang=en) locates the question to Abaye at [Menachot 70a:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.70a.6). At [Bava Batra 131a:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.131a.13), the passage first names Rav Nachumi, then gives Rav Chananya bar Minyumi as an alternative. [Zevachim 83b:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.83b.6) uses be-Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov, while [Menachot 26b:17](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.26b.17) and [Yoma 45b:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.45b.2) explicitly say “in the school of Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov.”
